main_text.p: Spiritualis vivificatio: Eph. 11, 10. Ioh. vi, 35, 47. xv, 5.
Peccatorum remissio ex propria auctoritate: Matth. ix, 6.
XV. Quarto denique Cultu Divino: unde generatim, Ioh. v. 23. Ut omnes honorent Filium, prout honorant Patrem.
Speciatim 1. de Adoratione: Hebr. 1. 6 - Adorent Eum omnes Angeli Dei. Phil. 1 1. 10, 11. 1 Cor. 1, 2. Rom. xiv. 10. 11.
2. De Fide, Spe, & Fiducia: Ioh. xiv, 1. Creditis in Deum, etiam in Me credite. Rom. xv. 12. - Erit radix Iesse: In ipso gentes sperabunt. 1 Cor. xv. 19. Psal. 2, 12.
3. De Baptismo in ipsius nomen: Matth. xxviii, 19. ac similiter de S. Coena in ipsius commemorationem: 1 Cor. xi, 24. 25. qui princeps salutis nostrae. Hebr. 2. 10. cum Act. iv. 12.

XVI. Proprietates distinctivae secundae Personae sunt, 1. Generatio passiva a Patre: Generaliori termino exortus, vel egressus; Mich. v, 1. Specialiori autem Generatio. Vide sup. th. 9. §. 2. Unde prima Persona, Πατὴρ ἰδίῳ; Ioh. v, 18. secunda autem, υἱὸς ἰδιος; Rom. v 111, 32. πρωτότοκος Hebr. 1, 6. Col. 1, 15. & μονογενὴς; Ioh. 1, 14. 18. 111, 16. 1, iv, 9. Quae Generatio non est physica; sed hyperphysica, & spiritualis: unde appellatio Λόγος, ἐν ἀρχῇ scil. ὁ ὑπόστατος; Ioh. 1, 1, 14. 1 Ioh. 1, 1, v, 7. & Sapientiae atque Intelligentiae; Prov. viii, 1. &c. Hinc Forma Dei, & Paritas cum Deo Patre; Phil. II, 5. Ioh. v, 18. Imago & Character Personae illius; 2Cor. iv, 4. Col. 1, 15. Hebr. 1. 3. quin & Unitas cum Patre; Ioh. x, 30.
2. Spiratio activa cum Patre; qua Filius cum Patre est principium tertiae Personae, Spiritus Sancti. Hinc Spiritus Filii dicitur Gal. iv, 6. Spiritus Christi; Rom. viii. 9.

page.notes: Printed text is partly faint; Greek and Hebrew-like terms in the paragraph beginning "XVI." are rendered as best read. Final line "VIII.9." appears as a right-aligned marginal reference and is included as printed. Some lines in the Greek terms are uncertain and may contain errors.
